| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `fabricName` | Name of the fabric (e.g., `"fabric1"`). |
| `nodeId` | Identifier of the node (e.g., `101`). |
| `podId` | Identifier of the pod (e.g., `5`). |
| `interfaceType` | Type of interface (`"svi"`, `"ethernet"`, `"loopback"`, or `"port-channel"`). |
| `infoType` | What you want to fetch (`"interfaces"`, `"status"`, `"statistics"`, or `"errors"`). |

Once you have those values, you can call the function like this:

```python
result = telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get(
    fabricName="fabric1",
    nodeId=101,
    podId=5,
    interfaceType="ethernet",
    infoType="statistics"
)
print(result)
```
